svg.title: 31 · FDC / WH_Channel/Logic
svg.text: ADDED · Freeze before payload, ordered branches 13-15. Sequence stays zero; final branch changes 10 -> 20.
ADDED · For mapped returns retain the complete item frozen immediately after the actual accepted-load scan.
ADDED · Physical return: reset the native TIMER and enter TimerState 10 before its single Post-rung RTO execution.
ADDED · Conflicting return/removal facts invalidate the timer; Ignition owns disposition.
